map.计算消火栓出水流量、压力损失与充实水柱长度: Compute hydrant discharge flow, pressure loss and fire-stream reach.
map.水枪喷嘴流量 q = 0.0348·dn²·√Pq（dn 喷嘴口径 mm，Pq: Nozzle flow q = 0.0348·dn²·√Pq (dn = nozzle diameter in mm, Pq = nozzle pressure in MPa, L/s); invert q = K√Pq to get Pq=(q/K)²; the fire-stream reach Sk follows nozzle pressure via the φ coefficient.
map.化简：q = 0.0348 × dn² × √Pq （q：L/s，dn：mm，P: Simplified: q = 0.0348 × dn² × √Pq (q: L/s, dn: mm, Pq: MPa)
map.校核：dn=19mm、Pq=0.25MPa → q≈6.3 L/s，与规范设计值: Check: dn=19 mm, Pq=0.25 MPa → q≈6.3 L/s, consistent with the code design value 6.5 L/s
map.本工具按 A×L×q² 形式等效（A 在 q≈5 L/s 处标定），可直接与规范: This tool uses the equivalent form A×L×q² (A calibrated at q≈5 L/s), which can be compared directly with the code tables
map.水带阻力系数 A 参考（每米，MPa/(m·(L/s)²)）: Hose resistance coefficient A reference (per metre, MPa/(m·(L/s)²))
map.切换水带口径时本工具会自动填入对应 A 值；换用新型聚氨酯衬里（C=150）可再: Switching the hose diameter automatically fills in the corresponding A value; using a new polyurethane lining (C=150) can reduce it by a further about 12%
map.Sk = Hq / (1 + φ·Hq)，Hq 为喷嘴压力水柱（m），φ 按喷嘴: Sk = Hq / (1 + φ·Hq), where Hq is the nozzle pressure head (m) and φ is taken by nozzle diameter
Check: 19 mm nozzle, Pq=0.235 MPa (Hq=23.5 m) → Sk≈19.1 m
map.室内消火栓充实水柱一般要求 ≥10m，高层建筑与厂房仓库 ≥13m: Indoor hydrant fire-stream reach is generally ≥10 m, and ≥13 m for high-rise buildings and factories/warehouses
map.本工具用于消防供水工程估算，正式设计应依据《消防给水及消火栓系统技术规范》GB: This tool is for fire water-supply engineering estimation; formal design should follow the Technical Code for Fire Protection Water Supply and Hydrant Systems (GB 50974).
map.📚 深度解析：消火栓出水流量计算: 📚 In-Depth Analysis: Hydrant Discharge Flow Calculation
map.火场供水时按栓口压力、水带口径长度与喷嘴直径估算实际出水流量与充实水柱。: In fire water supply, estimate the actual discharge flow and fire-stream reach from the hydrant outlet pressure, hose diameter/length and nozzle diameter.
map.设计审查中校核室内消火栓是否达到单栓 5 L/s 的流量基准。: In design review, verify whether an indoor hydrant reaches the single-hydrant flow benchmark of 5 L/s.
map.训练场演示不同水带口径/长度对出水流量与射程的衰减影响。: On the training ground, demonstrate how different hose diameters/lengths attenuate the discharge flow and throw.
map.DN65/25m/16mm 喷嘴、栓口 250 kPa 的核算: Verification for a DN65/25 m hose, 16 mm nozzle and 250 kPa outlet pressure
map.按默认参数（栓口压力 250 kPa、DN65 衬里水带、长度 25 m、喷嘴: With the default parameters (outlet pressure 250 kPa, DN65 lined hose, length 25 m, 16 mm nozzle): hose friction loss 7.1 kPa (0.71 m head), nozzle pressure head Hq = 24.3 m, nozzle coefficient φ = 0.0124; discharge flow q = 4.39 L/s (15.8 m³/h), fire-stream reach Sk = 18.7 m ≥ required 13.0 m, meeting the fire water-supply requirement. Note: the single-hydrant benchmark is 5 L/s; here 4.39 L/s is slightly below it, and a longer or larger-diameter hose would raise it further.
map.充实水柱 18.7 m 是够还是不够？: Is the fire-stream reach of 18.7 m enough or not?
map.室内消火栓充实水柱要求：高层建筑与厂房仓库 ≥13 m，其他建筑 ≥10 m。1: The indoor hydrant fire-stream reach requirement is ≥13 m for high-rise buildings and factories/warehouses and ≥10 m for other buildings. 18.7 m already meets the high-rise requirement; but to reach the single-hydrant benchmark of 5 L/s, the outlet pressure must be increased or the hose length shortened.
map.水带越长流量越低的原因？: Why is the flow lower with a longer hose?
map.水带沿程阻力损失随长度近似线性增加，消耗掉部分栓口压力，使喷嘴处压力下降、流量减: Hose friction loss increases roughly linearly with length, consuming part of the outlet pressure so the nozzle pressure drops and the flow decreases; hence long-distance supply often needs parallel mains or relay pressurization.
map.基于消防水力学公式，计算消火栓在给定栓口压力下的出水流量、喷嘴压力、水带阻力损失: Based on fire hydraulics formulas, compute the hydrant's discharge flow at a given outlet pressure, the nozzle pressure, the hose friction loss and the fire-stream reach.
